name: page-links
description: The same-origin links a web page shows once it has rendered in headless Chromium, in document order. Never cached.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: Load a page, wait for its network to go idle, and list each same-origin link once, in document order, with its text. Prints one URL per line, or the list with --json.

url.description: The page to read, such as a site's component catalog.

match.description: A regular expression a link's path must match, such as ^/components/[^/]+/?$.
